name: 0x0DEX
fix_description: In swapOnWithdrawal, the tokenOut and amountOut parameters are user-controlled without validation. Attacker can set amountOut to 0 (no slippage protection) and manipulate the swap price, or pass a malicious tokenOut. Fix: validate tokenOut against a whitelist, and enforce minimum amountOut based on oracle price.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires understanding a highly protocol-specific privacy DEX withdrawal/signature scheme, crafting custom ring-signature-like withdrawal data with bn256 precompile math, and chaining it with balance manipulation, forced ETH sends, repeated deposit/withdraw cycles, and a flash loan. Although the PoC is not extremely long, the vulnerability is non-obvious and would likely take an experienced auditor well over 2 hours to fully derive and reproduce.
